items.title: Heliodorus
items.charge: Attempting to plunder the temple treasury

items.title: Hezekiah and the ambassadors of Babylon
items.charge: Rendering not again according to the benefit done unto him, for his heart was lifted up; shewing all his treasures to the men of Babylon

items.title: Israel asking for a king
items.charge: Rejecting the Lord, that he should not reign over them, to be like all the nations

items.title: Jonah
items.charge: Rising up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the Lord instead of going to Nineveh to cry against it

items.title: Laban and the changed wages
items.charge: Changing his hired servant’s wages ten times, and giving the elder daughter in place of the younger

items.title: Moses and the uncircumcised son
items.charge: Neglecting the token of the covenant in his own house, on the road to demand the release of God’s firstborn

items.title: Moses at the waters of Meribah
items.charge: Failing to sanctify the Lord before the people: must we fetch you water out of this rock?

items.title: Nineveh under Jonah
items.charge: Wickedness come up before the Lord; and turning every one from his evil way, and from the violence that was in their hands

items.title: Peter at Antioch
items.charge: Dissembling: withdrawing from the Gentiles for fear of them of the circumcision

items.title: Peter’s denial
items.charge: Denying Christ three times with cursing and swearing

items.title: Simon Magus
items.charge: Offering money for the gift of the Holy Ghost

items.title: The barren fig tree
items.charge: Cumbering the ground three years without fruit

items.title: The church in Pergamos
items.charge: Holding among them the doctrine of Balaam and the doctrine of the Nicolaitans

items.title: The churches of Ephesus, Sardis, and Laodicea
items.charge: Leaving the first love; a name to live while dead; lukewarm, and saying, I am rich

items.title: The Sabbath traders of Jerusalem and Tyre
items.charge: Treading winepresses on the Sabbath, bringing in sheaves, lading asses with wine, grapes, and figs, and bringing burdens into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day; men of Tyre selling fish and all manner of ware on the Sabbath to the children of Judah
